title: A message to a new classmate
context_es: Empiezas un curso de inglés por internet. Tu profesora te pide que escribas un mensaje en el chat del grupo para presentarte a un compañero nuevo, Leo.
prompt_en: You are in a new online English class. Write a message to your classmate Leo. Tell him about you.
points: your name and where you are from
your job or what you study
what you like doing in your free time
useful_language: I work in … / I am a student.
In my free time I like …
tips_es: Empieza con un saludo (*Hi Leo,*) y termina con una despedida corta y tu nombre.
Frases cortas en presente: sujeto + verbo + lo demás.
model_answer:
Hi Leo,

My name is Marta and I am from Seville, in Spain. I am twenty-four years old. I work in a small bookshop. In my free time I like reading and playing tennis with my friends.

See you in class!
Marta
